fields.description: Stored checksum of slot-2 primary record: bitwise NOT of the u16-LE word sum of the other 5 words (FUN_0801fadc / FUN_0801fb08).
fields.evidence: FUN_0801fadc writes *buf = ~sum(words) over 0xC bytes; FUN_0801fb08 accepts iff word-sum == 0xFFFF and u32 buf[4]==len. Baseline save offset 0x6850: words fdf1 0001 000c 0000 0000 0201 sum to 0xFFFF.
fields.name: record_checksum

fields.description: Record tag / validity word of slot-2 primary record; nonzero means a valid record.
fields.evidence: FUN_08020890 initialises *(u16*)(RAMbuf+2)=1 for the 0xC-byte slot-2 record saved at save offset 0x6850 via FUN_08020908/FUN_0801f998; FUN_0801f970 returns nonzero iff *(u16*)(buf+2) != 0. Baseline holds 0x0001.
fields.name: record_tag

fields.description: Byte length of the slot-2 record (always 12 / 0x0C).
fields.evidence: FUN_0801fadc stores param_2 (0xC from FUN_08020890 and FUN_08020908/FUN_0801f998(2,buf,0xc)) as u32 at RAMbuf+4, i.e. save offset 0x6854; FUN_0801fb08 requires it to equal the record length. Baseline holds 0x0000000C.
fields.name: record_size

fields.description: Spare word of slot-2 primary record; zero in a fresh save.
fields.evidence: Bytes at RAMbuf+8..+9 (save offset 0x6858) are covered by the FUN_0801fb08 checksum and copied verbatim by the FUN_0801f864/FUN_0801fa24 save path and FUN_0801fa78 load path; FUN_08020890 defaults them to 0. Baseline holds 0x0000.
fields.name: record_spare

fields.description: Persisted config/option scalar A of the slot-2 record (fresh-save default 1).
fields.evidence: FUN_08020890 defaults byte at RAMbuf+10 (save offset 0x685A) to 1; byte is checksummed (FUN_0801fadc/FUN_0801fb08), saved by FUN_08020908/FUN_0801f998 slot 2 to save offset 0x685A and restored by FUN_0801fa78/FUN_0801f970. Baseline holds 0x01.
fields.name: config_value_a

fields.description: Persisted config/option scalar B of the slot-2 record (fresh-save default 2).
fields.evidence: FUN_08020890 defaults byte at RAMbuf+11 (save offset 0x685B) to 2; byte is checksummed (FUN_0801fadc/FUN_0801fb08), saved by FUN_08020908/FUN_0801f998 slot 2 to save offset 0x685B and restored by FUN_0801fa78/FUN_0801f970. Baseline holds 0x02.
fields.name: config_value_b

fields.description: Backup copy of the slot-2 record checksum at save offset 0x685C.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801fa24 saves each slot twice (primary SRAM address at table+8, backup at table+0xC); FUN_0801fa78 falls back to the backup copy. Baseline bytes at 0x685C match 0x6850 exactly; words sum to 0xFFFF per FUN_0801fb08.
fields.name: mirror_record_checksum

fields.description: Backup copy of the slot-2 record tag.
fields.evidence: Mirror of record_tag written by the FUN_0801fa24 dual-save path (backup table entry +0xC) and verified by FUN_0801fb08 on load via FUN_0801fa78. Baseline holds 0x0001.
fields.name: mirror_record_tag

fields.description: Backup copy of the slot-2 record length (always 12).
fields.evidence: Mirror of record_size written by the FUN_0801fa24 dual-save path; FUN_0801fb08 requires it to equal 0xC. Baseline holds 0x0000000C.
fields.name: mirror_record_size

fields.description: Backup copy of the slot-2 spare word.
fields.evidence: Mirror of record_spare written by the FUN_0801fa24 dual-save path and covered by the FUN_0801fb08 checksum. Baseline holds 0x0000.
fields.name: mirror_record_spare

fields.description: Backup copy of config scalar A.
fields.evidence: Mirror of config_value_a written by the FUN_0801fa24 dual-save path (backup table entry +0xC) and restored by FUN_0801fa78. Baseline holds 0x01.
fields.name: mirror_config_value_a

fields.description: Backup copy of config scalar B.
fields.evidence: Mirror of config_value_b written by the FUN_0801fa24 dual-save path (backup table entry +0xC) and restored by FUN_0801fa78. Baseline holds 0x02.
fields.name: mirror_config_value_b

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'COPY' header preserved from stub; verified at save offset 0.
